The '''Stellan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Hunnoverrs sector/Legends|Hunnoverrs sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the planet [[Stellan (planet)|Stellan]], home to the [[Stellan (species)|species]] of the same name.
